wrong_setting: The buses read as low-floor urban city buses rather than long-distance coaches, and the generic block skyline gives no sense of Addis Ababa.
notes: Repaint full-bleed with no ragged white paper margin or rounded corners, clear the figures out of the near foreground (bottom right and lower left), and swap the city buses for long-distance coaches in an Addis Ababa setting.
